name: @cookielab.io/klovi
description: Klovi — browse and present AI coding session history
author: Cookielab s.r.o.

scripts.build: bun run build:entrypoints && bun run build:web-assets && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.build:entrypoints:

#!/usr/bin/env node' dist/cli.js
